AMBIGUOUS_KEY.description: An upsert key matches more than one record, or one the user cannot read.

AUTH_EXPIRED.description: The bearer token (SN_AUTH=token) was rejected with 401 — rotate it.

BUSY.description: The per-host request queue is full or the wait timed out (SN_MAX_QUEUE / SN_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS).

CANCELLED.description: The client cancelled the tool call; nothing further was sent.

CHILD_NOT_WRITABLE.description: The child table is not a writable child of the artefact type.

CHILD_PARENT_INVALID.description: A nested child names no valid earlier parent.

CIRCUIT_OPEN.description: The per-host circuit breaker is open after consecutive failures.

CONFIRM_DECLINED.description: The user declined (or could not answer) the destructive-apply confirmation.

CONFIRM_REQUIRED.description: A destructive apply on a prod profile from a client that cannot confirm it.

CONFLICT.description: The call conflicts with the current state.

CREDENTIALS_INCOMPLETE.description: The credential change would leave a profile that cannot authenticate; nothing was saved.

CREDENTIALS_UNCONFIRMED.description: The user did not confirm the credential change; nothing was saved.

DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.description: The per-call deadline (SN_DEADLINE_MS) elapsed across attempts.

DOC_GENERATED.description: A docs-store write would cross the generated / hand-written line.

DUPLICATE_CHILD_KEY.description: Two children of one call share a key.

DUPLICATE_UNIQUE_FIELD.description: An instance-wide unique field value already exists or repeats in the plan.

ELEVATION_REQUIRED.description: A write to a table that needs an elevated role (security_admin) was refused with 403 — elevate in the UI or deliver it in an update set.

FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED.description: A field outside the artefact type's write allow-list.

INSTANCE_HTML_RESPONSE.description: The instance answered with an HTML page (hibernating PDI, login page) instead of JSON.

INSTANCE_HTTP_<status>.description: INSTANCE_HTTP_<status>: the instance answered with that non-2xx status and no more specific code applies; `detail` carries its error body.

INVALID_INPUT.description: The arguments are invalid; nothing was sent.

MIME_NOT_ALLOWED.description: An upload content type is not listed in SN_UPLOAD_MIME_ALLOW.

NOT_CONFIGURED.description: The profile lacks what its auth method needs; the hint names the missing fields.

NOT_FOUND.description: The named record, file or object does not exist.

NOT_REVERTIBLE.description: A write-journal entry cannot be reverted.

NO_PACKAGE_SESSION.description: The client session cannot change its package set.

PACKAGE_ALWAYS_ON.description: The package is always on and cannot be disabled.

PACKAGE_DENIED.description: The package is denied by SN_PACKAGES_DENY.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.description: A local payload (upload, document) exceeded its size cap.

PLAN_EXPIRED.description: The plan_token's preview expired; preview again and apply with the new token.

PLAN_ONLY_FIELD.description: The plan writes a field the registry marks writable:false; the apply is refused.

PLAN_REQUIRED.description: A destructive apply needs the plan_token of a matching plan preview; nothing was sent.

POLICY_DENIED.description: The table, package or read-only policy refused the call; the hint names the setting.

PREFLIGHT_INVALID.description: An SDK pre-flight rule refuses a value.

PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND.description: The named system property does not exist or is not readable.

RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.description: An email recipient is outside SN_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS or the instance's own directory.

REDIRECT_BLOCKED.description: The instance answered with a 3xx redirect; redirects are never followed.

REQUEST_FAILED.description: A request was refused for a reason no other code names.

RESERVED_PROFILE_NAME.description: The profile name is reserved (a servicenow:// resource segment); rename the profile.

SDK_MANAGED_SCOPE.description: SN_SDK_MANAGED_WRITES=deny and the record belongs to an SDK-managed scope.

STALE_RECORD.description: The record changed after the journaled write or the plan; force:true overrides.

TASKS_UNAVAILABLE.description: MCP tasks are unavailable for this call (SN_EXPERIMENTAL_TASKS).

TIMEOUT.description: A request attempt timed out (SN_TIMEOUT_MS) and retries were exhausted.

TOO_MANY_CHILDREN.description: More children on one table than the diff reads.

UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE.description: The instance answered 2xx with a body that is not the expected API shape.

UNKNOWN_PACKAGE.description: The name is not a known tool package.

UNKNOWN_PROFILE.description: The profile argument names no configured connection profile.

UNREACHABLE.description: The instance could not be reached (DNS, TLS, connection refused).

UNREADABLE.description: A local file the server needs (key, certificate, secret file) cannot be read.

UPDATE_SET_NOT_FOUND.description: The named update set does not exist or is not readable.

UPDATE_SET_NOT_IN_PROGRESS.description: A write was bound to an update set that is not in progress.

UPSTREAM_HTML.description: The error body was an HTML page (proxy, WAF, SSO) rather than an API body.

WATCH_LIMIT.description: A record-watch subscription would exceed SN_RECORD_WATCH_MAX_PER_SESSION or SN_RECORD_WATCH_MAX.

WRITE_CAP.description: A session or batch write cap would be exceeded; nothing was sent.

max_fields.description: Fields to take the max of.
